capabilities: Paint terrain, icons, and paths on an interactive hex map
Link hexes to town, dungeon, quest, and faction notes via a hex editor
Roll and manage weighted random tables and multi-step workflows
Overlay faction and region fills plus a GM-only hidden-content layer
Edit every hex note in a spreadsheet-style table view
disambiguation: Not an image-based battlemap or cartography tool; it draws abstract hex grids where every hex maps to a Markdown note.
extras: Readme warns that the Generate button requires folder settings to be configured first, and that vaults updated by a newer plugin version go read-only until the plugin is updated; it bundles the MiniSearch library for in-memory search.
problem: Obsidian has no way to draw or interact with a hex map, so TRPG worldbuilders cannot attach terrain, links, and GM notes to world geography directly in their vault.
summary: Hex-map worldbuilding toolbox that renders an interactive hex grid inside Obsidian, where each hex is a Markdown note for TRPG settings.
